viaje--skull-and-bones.description: Skull and Bones is Viaje's series of small, seasonal releases, begun in 2010 with sizes such as the Daisy Cutter, many of them named after bombs. The blend changes from edition to edition and is rarely disclosed, though Nicaraguan leaf has featured. Expect a strong, pepper-forward smoke that settles into coffee, earth and cedar; one for experienced smokers.
